sloka: ततस्तमुत्पाट्य जगाम वीरः संस्तूयमानो युधि राक्षसेन्द्रैः।शृण्वन्निनादं त्रिदशालयानां प्लवङ्गराजग्रहविस्मितानाम् ।। ६.६७.७१ ।।
transliteration: tatastamutpāṭya jagāma vīraḥ saṁstūyamāno yudhi rākṣasendraiḥ।śṛṇvanninādaṁ tridaśālayānāṁ plavaṅgarājagrahavismitānām ।। 6.67.71 ।।

translations.english: In the battlefield, the form of Kumbhakarna which resembled a huge cloud was distinguished in appearance like the lofty peak of mountain Meru.
